name: limit_detail_not_larger_than_view
why: REPORT 8CD843 N58 (round 16, 28/10/2026). A detail at 2:1 was taken from a view at 5:1 and accepted: on the sheet it came out smaller than the view it was asked to enlarge, 14.4 x 16.6 mm for a circle of 10 mm.
_what_changes_compared_to_the_twin: Only «scale»: 0.5 here, 2 in the twin. The front view of the plate is at scale 1 (measured on 27/10/2026, scenario t40), so 0.5 shrinks it; were the sheet at 1:2, 0.5 would be the same size, and that is refused too.
defect_caught: That a detail no larger than its view is drawn. The message must say that the scale is not larger than the one of the view, give a larger one, and say nothing was touched.

expect.why: the plate of the drawing cases
a drawing is made on a saved part
from here on the active document is the drawing
the front view is the one the detail is taken from

message_includes: is not larger than the scale of the view
